desc:
🏫 Welcome to Worst Class Ever!
One teacher. A classroom full of trouble. How much can you get away with?
🍫 Be a sneaky student
Eat snacks to earn points, raid empty desks, and throw school supplies to stun the teacher. Just don’t get caught chewing!
👀 Take charge as the teacher
Catch students breaking the rules and take them to detention. Write on the board for extra points—but watch what happens behind your back!
🛍️ Build your collection
Turn your points into coins and unlock new throwable items and premium snacks. More expensive supplies stun longer, and premium snacks earn more points!
🏆 Reach the top
Score as much as you can before the bell rings. Will you be the class troublemaker or the teacher nobody messes with?
📱 Play on mobile or PC.
